name: Santa Cruz Tree Map
prompt: i'd like an app that is about trees in a city - where the size, age, type, and status of the trees is shown and a map shows where they are all located. make the city santa cruz, ca.

thought_process.interpretation: The user is an urban planning or environmental analyst interested in the health and distribution of the urban canopy in Santa Cruz, CA. The application follows an 'Executive Summary' / 'Process Monitor' hybrid archetype, focusing on key performance indicators for tree health and age distribution, alongside a geospatial visualization of individual tree locations.
assumed_from_scratch: Data Table with search and row management
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A dedicated 'kpi_card_grid' skill would be useful to define standard tile spacing. A 'geospatial_utility' skill for coordinate jittering and map projection logic would also assist in more accurate mock spatial data.
